inventory_rationale: State 6 freezes the 20 accepted module operations plus the callable symbols required by deterministic http_router_backend/v1 before route rows may be authored: the access-control runtime port, app factory, credential extractor, principal resolver, and one canonical handler for each externally exposed State 5 operation. No additional implementation-private helpers are invented for coverage; reopen this plan only when later accepted evidence requires another stable callable seam.
